title: The Account Stats skill
summary: Your real scoreboard from Alpaca or any broker CSV: equity, today's P&L, return, worst drop, exposure, win rate, profit factor. As a block, an honest post or JSON. Knows the traps that make stats lie.

title: The Alert Inbox skill
summary: Forty trading emails a day into one morning brief: real alerts by ticker, newsletters in 2 lines, hype counted and ignored, scams flagged. Drafts replies, never sends, never trades.

title: Test a Viral Trading Strategy
summary: Turn a strategy from a reel, tweet or video into one exact rule, test it on years of real prices with costs, run the 5 honesty checks, and get a plain verdict (HELD UP / WEAK / FAILED / NOT ENOUGH TRADES).

title: The Trader Bias Audit
summary: One prompt makes your AI profile you as a trader from everything you've told it, then names the bias costing you the most and one rule to fix it.

title: The Bot Audit skill
summary: Six blind reviewers audit a trading bot before it touches money: backtest honesty, risk and kill switches, order bugs, leaked keys, data timing, overfitting. Findings JSON + plain report + verified fixes.

title: The Bot Brain meta-prompt
summary: The 9-part pattern behind serious AI products' instructions, and the meta-prompt that writes a pro-grade system prompt for your trading bot.

title: The Trading Data Lockdown
summary: What your AI has stored about your money and keys, the scam email that would work on you, and exactly what to delete today.

title: Drawdown Recovery Plan
summary: You're down and it hurts. A calm plan: stop the bleeding, find out what actually went wrong (system vs. you vs. market), cut size, and the exact conditions to scale back up.

title: The Earnings Game Plan skill
summary: Decide before the number drops: landmines table, the move options expect vs. the last four, three if/then scenarios, size math, minute-by-minute plan and a one-page cheat sheet.

title: The Equity Curve Video skill
summary: Equity curve CSV into a 12-second animated MP4: hook, the curve draws itself, the worst drop marked in red, final stats. Reel, square and wide presets.

title: The Yes-Man Off prompt
summary: Why your AI agrees with every trade idea, and the 10-line override that makes it act like a risk manager instead of a cheerleader.

title: Trading Hook Writer
summary: Ten ranked opening lines for a trading reel, carousel or post, each tagged with its hook family, tested against the 3-question hook test, plus a rewrite of your current hook. Honest by default.

title: Pre-Market Morning Brief
summary: A 2-minute pre-market brief for your watchlist: overnight moves, scheduled events today (earnings, economic data, Fed speakers), key levels, and what would change your plan. No predictions.

title: The Pine Script Writer
summary: Plain English to TradingView Pine Script v6, then checked for repainting, lookahead, unconfirmed-bar signals and missing costs. Webhook-ready alerts included.

title: Position Size Calculator (Never Blow Up)
summary: Work out exactly how many shares, contracts or coins to buy so one losing trade costs a fixed, small slice of your account, including gap risk and what to do when the math says the trade is too big.

title: 60-Second Pre-Trade Check
summary: Before you click buy, answer 8 questions out loud. Returns GO, WAIT or NO with the reason, and the exact stop and size if it's a GO.

title: Prop Firm Challenge Plan
summary: A day-by-day plan to pass a prop firm evaluation without breaking its rules: the daily loss and max drawdown math, the size that keeps you safe, how many good days you need, and a practice routine before paying the fee.

title: The AI B-Roll Prompt skill
summary: Twelve 2-second trading hooks for AI video models, a master prompt template, shot plans for 5 trading video types and a credit estimate before you generate.

title: The Reel Script skill
summary: Three hooks from different families ranked, a 45-second script with on-screen text and B-roll cues, caption, keyword CTA and a prediction against your own past reels.

title: The One-Ticker Research Committee
summary: Six AI roles review one ticker like a hedge fund committee (Macro, Fundamental, Technical, Risk Manager with a veto, Devil's Advocate, Portfolio Manager) and the PM returns PASS, WATCH or CANDIDATE with the reason.

title: The Saved Posts Sorter
summary: Your saved trading reels into a ranked shortlist of strategies worth testing. Parses your Instagram/TikTok export, pulls the claim and exact rule, scores testability.

title: The Skill Builder
summary: Turn anything you repeat as a trader into a reusable skill: intake, process, rules with reasons, output contract, self-check, stop-and-show. Tested on your real example.

title: The Strategy-to-Bot Spec skill
summary: Any trading idea into an exact build spec a developer or AI coder can build without guessing: every rule, data, timing, risk limits, kill switch, test plan, definition of done.

title: The Ticker Deep Dive skill
summary: Eight research passes into one 8-section brief: what they sell, the numbers, earnings pattern, insiders, chart, 90 days of news, catalysts, the bear case. Every fact sourced.

title: The Trade Carousel skill
summary: Carousel about a trade or backtest: giant-number hook slide, content slides, keyword CTA, caption. HTML to 1080x1350 PNGs plus a PDF DM asset. Dark and light.

title: Weekly Trade Journal Review
summary: Paste or upload your trades and notes for the week; get the numbers, the rule breaks, the one pattern costing you the most, and one rule to change for next week.

title: The Trade Recap Post skill
summary: An honest trade post for X, Threads, StockTwits or LinkedIn. One true detail, a first line that survives the cut, the loss next to the win. Refuses to write without a real number.

title: Build Your Trading Dashboard App
summary: Your own private dashboard on a link: watchlist, alert log via webhook, bot status with a KILL switch, weekly scoreboard. The exact starter prompt and the build order that avoids dead ends.

title: The Trading Plan skill
summary: Your written trading plan: your honest rung on the Bot Ladder, one market that fits your time and money, risk rules first, a 90-day path from manual to automated, the don't-do list and a weekly scoreboard. HTML + PDF.

title: The Watchlist Pull skill
summary: Plain-English market idea into a screened, deduped, ranked watchlist CSV plus a TradingView import line and a why-each-one note. Resumable, free data, logs every drop.
